name: Yamaha YR1 / YR2 350
engine: 348 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, two carbs, Autolube oil injection
intro: Yamaha's first 350 twin, the start of the line that led to the R5 and RD350.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.
It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
